course.learn: A hybrid environment combines on-premises resources with cloud services. Security must cover identity, networking, logging, data movement, and policy consistently across both sides.
course.why: Different control planes and trust boundaries can create gaps if teams manage each environment separately.
course.example: An organization keeps a database on-premises while application servers run in the cloud and connect through a private link.
course.exam: Hybrid clues: on-prem + cloud together. Pay attention to connectivity, consistent IAM, data location, and monitoring.
